title: Adaptive retention credits router + contract-onboarding flow
creator: Claire Chen
description: Experiment to introduce an adaptive credit router that dynamically maps tenant-level observability retention choices to priced credit bundles and surfaces a contract/security-questionnaire onboarding path for enterprise customers requesting extended retention or premium SLA. Goal is to validate revenue uplift, reduce manual entitlement work, and improve legal onboarding throughput.
background: Current observability retention offering is static tiers (30/90/365). Enterprise customers request bespoke retention and SLA bundles which require manual sales/legal work and ad-hoc entitlement changes. This creates friction, delays contract execution, and increases ops load. We have prior experiments around tiered retention and add-on entitlements but lack an automated gating and pricing router that ties to the security questionnaire flow.
proposed_solution: Build a lightweight 'Retention Credit Router' service in the Console: 1) UI to let admins choose retention windows per route with recommended credit estimates; 2) API + rule engine to map selection to pricing SKU and contract template; 3) Trigger a guided security-questionnaire flow for selections above baseline; 4) Generate draft contract addendum (SLA/retention) and flag for Legal review if high-risk answers are present; 5) Emit telemetry for cost/latency impact and contract conversion tracking.
tradeoffs:
- Full automation speeds onboarding but increases legal exposure if questionnaire logic misses nuance; mitigated by conservative gating and mandatory manual review for certain answers.
- More granular retention options could increase runtime storage costs unpredictably; use credit estimates and soft caps.
- Tight timeline means initial MVP will be rule-based rather than ML-driven recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Console UI exposes retention slider and shows estimated credit consumption per tenant route
Router maps selections to SKU and updates tenant billing metadata via billing API
Selections that require security review launch the questionnaire and block final activation until answered
Legal receives auto-created draft addendum for cases marked high-risk and can approve/reject in the console
Telemetry surfaces retention selection, estimated vs actual credit burn, and time-to-contract metrics in the experiment dashboard
success_metrics: Increase in conversion of bespoke retention requests to paid add-ons from 12% -> 45% within 8 weeks
Reduction in average legal review turnaround from 7 days -> 48 hours for flagged cases
<10% of activations require rollback due to SLA/security mismatches
Clear mapping of estimated vs actual per-tenant retention credit variance within +/-20%
rollout_plan: MVP feature flag behind enterprise tier: internal dogfood + 3 pilot customers (week 1-2)
Collect telemetry and qualitative feedback; iterate questionnaire prompts and rules (week 3-4)
Open to sales-assisted customers via Controlled Launch and train SEs on new flow (week 5-8)
Post-pilot: enable self-serve for customers on Dedicated with optional legal review flow (Q2 planning)
